incidents.title: Who is Fatima El Mansouri, Morocco’s first woman prime minister?

incidents.title: As Iran’s grip on Hormuz weakens, what leverage does Tehran have left?
incidents.blurb: Six months into the war, Iran's grip on the Strait of Hormuz is weakening. The world is slowly learning to live with it, oil flows are recovering, alternative routes are expanding and Tehran's own economy is bearing the cost of keeping the waterway under pressure.

incidents.title: Saudi stocks hit wartime low as Aramco slides, Gulf oil exports rebound
incidents.blurb: Saudi Arabia’s Tadawul All-Share Index fell 1.17% on Tuesday, dragged down by oil giant Aramco, as investors digested signs that Gulf oil exports are recovering.
